name: plushbucket-native
description: iPhone and Android apps for Plushbucket, wrapping the website's index.html with Capacitor

scripts.add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
